description: Entity: Rose. Play a YouTube video immediately on the HDMI screen with autoplay enabled. Replaces the current video; there is no queue. Confirms that this video is playing, or returns a startup error within 20 seconds. Does not wait for the video to finish; continue the conversation and other tools.

video_id.description: The 11-character YouTube video ID returned by search or extracted from a link.

muted.description: True starts muted; false plays audio through the system speaker.
